Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
神农和他的家人住在古代，所以不知道什么植物能吃。因为他的家人常常生病了，所以神农和他的哥哥一起去旅行找可以吃的植物。他们去很多不一样的地方，比方说高山、山谷和沙漠。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the family’s illnesses, add Shennong’s feeling to show his motivation more clearly: “神农很担心家人的身体。”
2. When describing the journey, add one action detail to make the travel more vivid: “他们翻过高山，穿过山谷。”
3. Add a short line of speech before the journey: “神农说：‘我要找到可以吃的植物。’”

ideas.reason: It adds a fitting personal feeling that explains why Shennong wants to help his family.
It gives concrete, story-appropriate travel actions without repeating the learner's wording.
The learner already says that Shennong travels to find plants that can be eaten.
